biggest_catch: The friend must make two or more external direct deposits of $500+ each within 90 days of account opening — the $50 reward depends on real payroll-level direct deposits.
catches: Friend must open a new Elements Financial personal checking account and complete requirements within 90 days of account opening.
Friend-side requirements: two (2) or more external direct deposits of $500 or more each.
